edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against escrow in the onlyEscrow modifier guarding withdrawEther.
msg.sender is compared against escrow in the onlyEscrow modifier guarding withdrawNAC.
onlyEscrow restricts withdrawTopForTeam to the escrow address.
State variable escrow is the authorization source for withdrawEther.
namiMultiSigWallet is the fixed recipient of the ETH transfer in withdrawEther.
withdrawEther executes the external namiMultiSigWallet.transfer call.
withdrawNAC executes the external token transfer to the multisig wallet.
NamiAddr is used to instantiate the token contract for the NAC transfer.
namiPool stake of the shareholder feeds the ethReturn computation and payout.
round.ethBalance and round.finalNAC feed the ETH payout amount.
withdrawTopForTeam transfers ETH to _shareAddress before setting isWithdrawn.
withdrawTopForTeam calls the internal _withdrawNAC after the external ETH transfer.
_withdrawNAC performs an external token transfer to the shareholder.
withdrawNonTopForTeam invokes _withdrawNAC, extending the external call chain.
withdrawTop transfers ETH to msg.sender before marking isWithdrawn true.
withdrawTop calls _withdrawNAC after the ETH transfer, allowing reentrant NAC payout.
withdrawNonTop calls _withdrawNAC during payout.
msg.sender indexes namiPool and is the ETH recipient in withdrawTop.
msg.sender indexes namiPool and is the NAC recipient in withdrawNonTop.
onlyEscrow gates depositEthPool through msg.sender comparison.
block.timestamp is stored/emitted by activateRound via now.
block.timestamp is emitted in UpdateShareHolder from tokenFallbackExchange.
block.timestamp is emitted in WithdrawPool from withdrawEthPool.
closeSession timing checks depend on now and block.timestamp.
isOwner from the multisig wallet gates whether _withdraw.transfer executes.
transferToExchange invokes tokenFallbackExchange on the receiving contract.
executeTransaction performs an arbitrary external call with value.
The callee can re-enter executeTransaction while executed is still false on failure.
closeSession calls NamiCrowdSale.buy with value inside the investor loop.
withdrawTopForTeam computes ethReturn with mul and div on pool balances.
The computed ethReturn directly determines the transferred ETH amount.
sellNac sends ETH to msg.sender via send before updating the bid order.
withdrawEthPool performs an external ETH transfer to the multisig wallet.
closeBidOrder transfers ETH to msg.sender before clearing the order.
msg.sender is passed as the buyer into buy from the payable fallback.
tokenFallbackExchange writes the accumulated stake into namiPool.
withdrawTopForTeam reads and depends on the Round struct state.
The _amount parameter flows directly into the namiMultiSigWallet.transfer call.
The _shareAddress parameter is the recipient of the ETH transfer.
The _roundIndex parameter selects the round used by withdrawTop.
The _value parameter is added to the shareholder stake in tokenFallbackExchange.
The ethReturn local variable is the exact ETH amount transferred out.
previousBalances is compared against the post-transfer token balance in _withdrawNAC.

normalization_plan.reason: The _amount parameter has no independent semantics; it is only used as the value of the ETH transfer in withdrawEther and should be folded into that unsafe operation.
_shareAddress is only meaningful as the recipient of the ETH transfer, so it collapses into the transfer unsafe operation.
_roundIndex is a plain index used solely by withdrawTop and does not carry independent semantic weight.
_value is only used to increment stake and currentNAC inside the callback, so it merges into that function.
ethReturn is a temporary result immediately passed to the ETH transfer and should be merged into the payout operation.
previousBalances is only a snapshot used to assert around the token transfer, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
